candidates.change_summary: Change the declared return type of decimals() in the iBEP20 interface from uint8 to uint16, which alters the observable return value when decimals() is called.
Change totalSupply() to return a constant different from state to alter observed totalSupply value.
candidates.mutated_unit_code: function totalSupply() external view returns (uint256) { return 1; }

candidates.change_summary: Relax onlyPool modifier to allow calls when POOLFACTORY reports false (changed require to allow either curated or DEPLOYER), altering which callers can invoke pool-only functions and thus which pool keys affect mapSynth_LPBalance after mintSynth.
Change mintSynth to increment mapSynth_LPDebt[msg.sender] by amount*2 instead of amount.
Change mintSynth to increment mapSynth_LPDebt[msg.sender] by zero (no change) instead of amount.
Change mintSynth to increment mapSynth_LPDebt[member] (key = member) instead of mapSynth_LPDebt[msg.sender].
Change onlyPool modifier to require false for msg.sender instead of checking isCuratedPool, preventing pools from calling mintSynth (affects mapSynth_LPDebt updates by blocking calls).
